name: Mushroom Pizza

descriptions.normal: A pizza covered in cheese and mushrooms. When still warm, the cheese becomes stretchy and gooey, making it extremely satisfying to eat.
descriptions.suspicious: A pizza covered in cheese and mushrooms. If you can bite through the brick-like texture... At least it can ease your hunger.
descriptions.delicious: A pizza covered in cheese and mushrooms. It's a party in your mouth and the cheese and mushrooms invited all their delicious friends.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 28% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 620 HP every 5s for 30s.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 450 HP every 5s for 30s.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 790 HP every 5s for 30s.

recipeHint: Chest in Stormterror's Lair Complete step 1 of Food From Afar
